sample_count_total.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM reporting.sample_headers WHERE isactive = true

individual_sample_count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM reporting.sample_details sd INNER JOIN reporting.sample_headers sh ON sh.source_id = sd.sample_header_id WHERE sh.isactive = true

sample_count_pending_review.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM reporting.sample_headers WHERE status IN ('Samples Request Review', 'Sample Verification', 'Sample Approval') AND isactive = true GROUP BY status
sample_count_pending_review.description: Counts of batches currently awaiting laboratory review, verification stages, or final approval sign-off. Use this for queries about verification.

sample_count_in_lab.sql: SELECT COUNT(sd.source_id) as n FROM reporting.sample_details sd INNER JOIN reporting.sample_headers sh ON sh.source_id = sd.sample_header_id WHERE (sh.status = 'Samples In Lab' OR sh.status = 'In Lab') AND sh.isactive = true
sample_count_in_lab.description: Total number of individual sample items or aliquots currently inside the lab being processed.

batch_count_in_lab.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM reporting.sample_headers sh WHERE (sh.status = 'Samples In Lab' OR sh.status = 'In Lab') AND sh.isactive = true
batch_count_in_lab.description: Sample batches (headers) currently in the lab for processing

samples_by_status.sql: SELECT COALESCE(sh.status, 'Unknown') as status, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM reporting.sample_headers sh WHERE sh.isactive = true GROUP BY COALESCE(sh.status, 'Unknown') ORDER BY cnt DESC
samples_by_status.description: Distribution of samples across workflow stages

batch_count_total.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM reporting.sample_headers WHERE isactive = true

sample_count_today.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM reporting.sample_headers WHERE isactive = true AND source_created_at::timestamptz::date = CURRENT_DATE

sample_tests_by_parameter.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tc.sample_header_id) as n FROM reporting.tat_captured tc JOIN reporting.sample_headers sh ON sh.source_id = tc.sample_header_id WHERE sh.isactive = true AND tc.source_created_at::timestamptz::date BETWEEN CAST(:date_start AS date) AND CAST(:date_end AS date) AND LOWER(COALESCE(tc.payload::text, '')) LIKE :analyte_name_like
sample_tests_by_parameter.description: Samples tested for the requested parameter

sample_count_this_week.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM reporting.sample_headers WHERE isactive = true AND source_created_at::timestamptz >= DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)

sample_count_this_month.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM reporting.sample_headers WHERE isactive = true AND source_created_at::timestamptz >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)

samples_rejected.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM reporting.sample_headers WHERE isactive = true AND LOWER(COALESCE(status, '')) IN ('rejected', 'cancelled', 'sample rejected')

latest_received_batches.sql: SELECT batch_code, status, source_created_at::timestamptz::date as received_date FROM reporting.sample_headers WHERE isactive = true ORDER BY source_created_at DESC LIMIT 10

daily_ingestion_trend.sql: SELECT source_created_at::timestamptz::date as day, COUNT(*) as batches FROM reporting.sample_headers WHERE source_created_at::timestamptz >= CAST(:date_start AS timestamptz) AND isactive = true GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC

sample_type_distribution.sql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(sh.payload->>'sample_type_id'), ''), 'Unknown') as sample_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM reporting.sample_headers sh WHERE sh.isactive = true GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(sh.payload->>'sample_type_id'), ''), 'Unknown') ORDER BY count DESC
sample_type_distribution.description: Sample volume breakdown by specimen/matrix type

sample_details_lookup.sql: SELECT sh.batch_code, sh.status, c.name as client, sh.source_created_at::timestamptz::date as registered_on FROM reporting.sample_headers sh LEFT JOIN reporting.clients c ON sh.crm_customer_id = c.source_id WHERE sh.batch_code = :batch_code AND sh.isactive = true LIMIT 1
sample_details_lookup.description: Detailed status and ownership for a specific sample batch

inventory_low_stock.sql: SELECT c.name as category, sc.name as subcategory, COALESCE(ii.payload->>'batch_code', 'N/A') as batch_code, ii.stock_in, sc.minimum_level FROM reporting.inventory_items ii INNER JOIN reporting.inventory_sub_categories sc ON ii.inventory_sub_category_id = sc.source_id INNER JOIN reporting.inventory_categories c ON sc.inventory_category_id = c.source_id WHERE ii.stock_in < sc.minimum_level ORDER BY (sc.minimum_level - ii.stock_in) DESC LIMIT 10
inventory_low_stock.description: Items below minimum reorder level (shortage analysis)

inventory_order_status.sql: SELECT io.order_number, s.name as supplier, io.status as fulfillment_status, io.source_created_at FROM reporting.inventory_orders io LEFT JOIN reporting.suppliers s ON io.supplier_id = s.source_id WHERE io.status IN ('not_fulfilled', 'partially_fulfilled') ORDER BY io.source_created_at DESC LIMIT 10

supplier_order_performance.sql: SELECT s.name as supplier, COUNT(io.source_id) as total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN io.status = 'fulfilled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as fulfilled, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN io.status = 'fulfilled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(io.source_id), 0), 1) as fulfillment_pct FROM reporting.suppliers s JOIN reporting.inventory_orders io ON s.source_id = io.supplier_id WHERE io.source_created_at >= CAST(:date_start AS timestamptz) GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY fulfillment_pct ASC LIMIT 10

inventory_stock_by_category.sql: SELECT c.name as category, COUNT(ii.source_id) as item_count, SUM(ii.stock_in) as total_stock, SUM(CASE WHEN ii.stock_in < sc.minimum_level THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as below_minimum FROM reporting.inventory_categories c JOIN reporting.inventory_sub_categories sc ON sc.inventory_category_id = c.source_id JOIN reporting.inventory_items ii ON ii.inventory_sub_category_id = sc.source_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY below_minimum DESC
inventory_stock_by_category.description: Inventory health summary grouped by category

inventory_expiring_soon.sql: SELECT sc.name as item, c.name as category, ii.payload->>'expiry' as expiry_date, ii.stock_in as quantity FROM reporting.inventory_items ii INNER JOIN reporting.inventory_sub_categories sc ON ii.inventory_sub_category_id = sc.source_id INNER JOIN reporting.inventory_categories c ON sc.inventory_category_id = c.source_id WHERE ii.payload->>'expiry' IS NOT NULL AND (ii.payload->>'expiry')::date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY (ii.payload->>'expiry')::date ASC LIMIT 15
inventory_expiring_soon.description: Inventory items expiring within the next 30 days

equipment_utilization.sql: SELECT e.name as name, COUNT(eu.source_id) as usage_count, MAX(eu.event_date) as last_used FROM reporting.equipment_assets e LEFT JOIN reporting.equipment_logs eu ON e.source_id = eu.equipment_id WHERE eu.event_date >= CAST(:date_start AS text) GROUP BY e.source_id, e.name ORDER BY usage_count DESC LIMIT 10

equipment_maintenance_schedule.sql: SELECT name, CAST(maintenance_due_date AS DATE) as next_maintenance_due, assigned_department FROM reporting.equipment_due_status WHERE (CAST(maintenance_due_date AS DATE)) BETWEEN NOW() AND NOW() + INTERVAL '30 days' AND maintenance_status != 'overdue' ORDER BY maintenance_due_date LIMIT 10

equipment_downtime_summary.sql: SELECT name, source_id FROM reporting.equipment_due_status WHERE maintenance_status = 'overdue' ORDER BY maintenance_due_date ASC LIMIT 5

equipment_count_active.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM reporting.equipment_assets WHERE active = true
equipment_count_active.description: Total active instruments in the system

qc_pass_rate.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completions FROM reporting.sample_headers WHERE isactive = true AND approval_date_at IS NOT NULL

qc_drifting_analytes.sql: SELECT analyte_name, robust_cv_pct, pass_rate_pct FROM reporting.v_qc_stability_metrics WHERE robust_cv_pct > 15 ORDER BY robust_cv_pct DESC
qc_drifting_analytes.description: Analytes showing warning or critical instability

capa_pending.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM reporting.corrective_actions WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(status, '')) NOT IN ('closed', 'completed', 'cancelled')

samples_pending_qc.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM reporting.sample_headers sh WHERE (sh.status = 'Quality Control' OR sh.status = 'Sample QC') AND sh.isactive = true AND LOWER(COALESCE(sh.status, '')) NOT IN ('completed', 'approved')

complaints_trend.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', source_created_at::timestamptz)::date as month, COUNT(*) as complaints FROM reporting.complaints WHERE source_created_at::timestamptz >= (NOW() - INTERVAL '6 months') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month DESC
complaints_trend.description: Monthly complaint volume trend for the last 6 months

audit_findings_open.sql: SELECT COALESCE(category, 'Uncategorized') as category, COUNT(*) as open_count FROM reporting.audit_findings WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(status, '')) NOT IN ('closed', 'resolved') GROUP BY category ORDER BY open_count DESC
audit_findings_open.description: Open audit findings grouped by category

tat_overall_average.sql: SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tat_overdue_days * 24.0), 1), 0) as avg_tat_hours FROM reporting.tat_captured WHERE source_created_at::timestamptz >= CAST(:date_start AS timestamptz) AND is_complete = true
tat_overall_average.description: Mean laboratory turnaround time in hours

tat_overdue_batches.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sample_header_id) as overdue_batches FROM reporting.tat_captured WHERE tat_overdue_days > 0 AND is_complete = false AND source_created_at::timestamptz >= CAST(:date_start AS timestamptz)
tat_overdue_batches.description: Total count of overdue or late sample batches

tat_by_analyte.sql: SELECT a.name as analyte, ROUND(AVG(tc.tat_overdue_days * 24.0), 1) as avg_hours, COUNT(*) as test_count FROM reporting.tat_captured tc JOIN reporting.analytes a ON tc.analyte_id = a.source_id WHERE tc.source_created_at::timestamptz >= CAST(:date_start AS timestamptz) GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY avg_hours DESC LIMIT 10
tat_by_analyte.description: Average TAT in hours per analyte — bottleneck analysis

tat_sla_compliance.sql: SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN tat_overdue_days <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1), 0) as sla_pct FROM reporting.tat_captured WHERE source_created_at::timestamptz >= CAST(:date_start AS timestamptz) AND is_complete = true
tat_sla_compliance.description: Percentage of batches completed within SLA target

sla_compliance.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN resolution_sla_status = 'Achieved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as compliant FROM reporting.complaints WHERE source_created_at::timestamptz >= (NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days')
sla_compliance.description: Support ticket SLA compliance rate for the last quarter

ticket_backlog_priority.sql: SELECT priority, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM reporting.complaints WHERE is_closed = false GROUP BY priority ORDER BY cnt DESC
ticket_backlog_priority.description: Open support tickets categorized by business priority

ticket_resolution_time.sql: SELECT priority, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_time::timestamptz - source_created_at::timestamptz)) / 3600), 1) as avg_resolution_hours FROM reporting.complaints WHERE resolved_time IS NOT NULL AND source_created_at::timestamptz >= (NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days') GROUP BY priority ORDER BY avg_resolution_hours DESC
ticket_resolution_time.description: Average resolution time in hours per priority (last quarter)

tickets_by_department.sql: SELECT current_department, COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN is_closed = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as open_count FROM reporting.complaints WHERE source_created_at::timestamptz >= (NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days') GROUP BY current_department ORDER BY open_count DESC LIMIT 10
tickets_by_department.description: Ticket distribution and backlog by department

complaint_count_open.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM reporting.complaints WHERE is_closed = false

equipment_maintenance_health.sql: SELECT maintenance_status, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM reporting.equipment_due_status GROUP BY maintenance_status
equipment_maintenance_health.description: Inventory of instrument maintenance states (Overdue, Pending, Healthy)

equipment_verification_status.sql: SELECT e.name, vl.event_type, vl.source_created_at::timestamptz::date as last_event FROM reporting.equipment_assets e LEFT JOIN reporting.equipment_logs vl ON e.source_id = vl.equipment_id WHERE vl.source_id IN (SELECT MAX(source_id) FROM reporting.equipment_logs GROUP BY equipment_id) ORDER BY last_event ASC LIMIT 15

analyst_verifications.sql: SELECT u.name, COUNT(sh.source_id) as batches_verified FROM reporting.users u JOIN reporting.sample_headers sh ON u.source_id = sh.verify_user_id WHERE sh.source_created_at::timestamptz >= (NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') AND u.active = true GROUP BY u.name ORDER BY batches_verified DESC LIMIT 15
analyst_verifications.description: Batches verified per analyst in the last 30 days

analyst_approvals.sql: SELECT u.name, COUNT(sh.source_id) as batches_approved FROM reporting.users u JOIN reporting.sample_headers sh ON u.source_id = sh.approve_user_id WHERE sh.source_created_at::timestamptz >= (NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') AND u.active = true GROUP BY u.name ORDER BY batches_approved DESC LIMIT 15
analyst_approvals.description: Batches approved per analyst in the last 30 days

analyst_workload_today.sql: SELECT u.name as analyst, COUNT(sh.source_id) as batches_touched FROM reporting.users u JOIN reporting.sample_headers sh ON u.source_id IN (sh.verify_user_id, sh.approve_user_id) WHERE sh.source_updated_at::timestamptz::date = CURRENT_DATE AND u.active = true GROUP BY u.name ORDER BY batches_touched DESC LIMIT 15

top_clients_by_volume.sql: SELECT c.name as client, COUNT(sh.source_id) as sample_batches FROM reporting.clients c JOIN reporting.sample_headers sh ON c.source_id = sh.crm_customer_id WHERE sh.source_created_at::timestamptz >= (NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days') AND sh.isactive = true GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY sample_batches DESC LIMIT 10
top_clients_by_volume.description: Top 10 customers by submission volume in the last quarter

inactive_clients.sql: SELECT c.name, MAX(sh.source_created_at::timestamptz)::date as last_submission FROM reporting.clients c LEFT JOIN reporting.sample_headers sh ON c.source_id = sh.crm_customer_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING MAX(sh.source_created_at::timestamptz) < (NOW() - INTERVAL '60 days') OR MAX(sh.source_created_at) IS NULL ORDER BY last_submission ASC NULLS FIRST
inactive_clients.description: Clients with no submissions in the last 60 days (churn risk)

client_submission_today.sql: SELECT c.name as client, COUNT(sh.source_id) as batches_today FROM reporting.clients c JOIN reporting.sample_headers sh ON c.source_id = sh.crm_customer_id WHERE sh.source_created_at::timestamptz::date = CURRENT_DATE AND sh.isactive = true GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY batches_today DESC LIMIT 15
